scope_limits: Only the specified exact-real four-block graph, one coefficient and declared fixed-source/special-eta family are covered; not arbitrary perturbations, all networks or a source-class minimax lower bound.
The coefficient absolute change is 4|eta|; for eta=1/(2q) it is 2/q. Preserve this distinction from score-relative eta.
The fixed-q model is fixed across N. Triangular q_N or safe eta_N sequences change weights with N; perturbation tending to zero separately needs q_N tending to infinity.
A sufficient two-sided exact-output window and a particular positive failing sequence do not establish a sharp threshold, monotonicity, outside-window necessity or an optimal onset exponent.
